signature_awards.description: Ten minutes after closing the tab, is there one specific thing from the page she'd remember and mention to someone?
signature_awards.why: MENUE.HTML baked onto the loaf is exactly the thing I'd text a friend: 'the 404 bakes your typo into bread.'

signature_awards.description: Does the page leave a lost web visitor wanting to walk into the shop, with a concrete reason and enough practical info (when, where) to act on it today?
signature_awards.why: Week grid with today ringed and 'sourdough, a few tables, coffee' lets me plan the visit; no live open-now or address.

signature_awards.description: Does the page still work with JavaScript disabled and before web fonts load, and is the file lean?
signature_awards.why: 3.7KB; hours, headline and all three links are static HTML; JS only fills a status line and path; fonts swap but layout holds.

signature_awards.description: Can a keyboard or screen-reader visitor reach and activate Home in three Tabs or fewer, with a strong visible focus indicator and link names that make sense out of context?
signature_awards.why: Home is the first link (1 Tab), full-width 48px rows with descriptive hints, an inverted-fill focus state with the default outline kept, and the hours table is real semantic content with today marked in text, not colour alone.

signature_awards.description: Can every word of visible copy on the first screen be read in about ten seconds, with nothing cuttable?
signature_awards.why: Tightest first screen: headline, one line, status, three buttons; still says 'sold out' and 'nothing in the oven' for the same idea, and repeats the path twice.

criteria.name: Recovery & clarity
criteria.description: Instantly clear the page wasn't found; home, menu and opening hours (7am-2pm, closed Mondays) are obvious and one tap away.

criteria.name: Sense of place
criteria.description: Feels unmistakably like this small neighbourhood sourdough bakery, not a generic 404 or another team's page.

criteria.name: Concept strength
criteria.description: One clear, ownable idea you can say in a sentence, and it's surprising.

criteria.name: Craft & execution
criteria.description: Finished and polished; one self-contained index.html, works at 375px and desktop, respects prefers-reduced-motion.

criteria.name: Pitch
criteria.description: Short, persuasive, honest about risk; makes the bakery owner want to say yes.
